sketch: One of the most decorated names in BPL history, Sketch is a Singaporean rifler who has been a constant through Aimpunch's championship era. His six trophies span the club's entire run — from the 2020 opener at BPL Tournament Minor 1 to the 2023 BPL Conquerors Major — and few players can match that longevity at the top. A steady, no-frills fragger, he has always let his consistency do the talking.
idiotangelcrutcher: AngelCrutcher is the utility man of Aimpunch's dynasty, a Singaporean flex player who has slotted into whatever role the roster demanded across six title runs. His numbers rarely top the scoreboard, but his willingness to play the thankless positions was a quiet cornerstone of one of the league's great teams.
mond33: mond33__ has held the AWP for Aimpunch through all six of the club's championships, a Singaporean sniper whose composure on the big rounds helped define their dynasty. Her raw rating sits modestly, but a résumé that includes the 2023 BPL Conquerors Major speaks to a player who delivers when the trophies are on the line.
chiaifujikawa: The voice behind Aimpunch's championship run, Chiai Fujikawa is a Malaysian in-game leader who calls the shots for one of BPL's most successful sides. A four-time champion — headlined by the 2023 BPL Conquerors Major — he pairs a tactical mind with real firepower, carrying a Diamond-tier 1.07 rating and a 1.13 K/D that few IGLs can match.
balililmao: balililmao is a Singaporean rifler and a four-time BPL champion with Aimpunch, a dependable presence across the club's 2022–2023 title haul. Steady rather than spectacular, she has been a trusted piece of the rotation through some of the league's biggest matches, including the 2023 Conquerors Major.
vplh: VPLH captains New Jade and ranks among the elite of the pool, a Singaporean in-game leader who leads from the front. A two-time BPL Legends Stage champion — first in 2022, again in 2025 — she blends her calling with a rare fragging output for an IGL, backing a Grandmaster 1.14 rating with a 1.24 K/D.
sanctuary: SanCtuary is the highest-rated player in the pro pool, a Singaporean in-game leader who has turned Artisian into a genuine contender. A Grandmaster at 1.15, he marries elite individual form with the responsibility of calling — a rare combination — and already owns a BPL Challengers Stage title from 2022.
sneakyyyyy: sneakyyyyy is one of the sharpest fraggers in the league, a Singaporean rifler for Cosmos whose Grandmaster 1.14 rating is built on a punishing 1.25 K/D. He announced himself with a Major run at the 2025 BPL Conquerors Stage and remains one of the most dangerous individual players in any given match.
tanykeat: tanykeat is a Master-tier in-game leader for Alcheministry, a Singaporean caller who backs his tactics with a healthy 1.13 K/D. A winner of the 2025 BPL Ranking Reshuffle, he sits among the higher-rated leaders in the pool.
solaonix: Solaonix is a Master-tier rifler for 5PERCENT and one of the pool's most efficient fraggers, a Singaporean player carrying a standout 1.29 K/D. She claimed silverware at Bot Pro Minor League 13 and has the individual ceiling to trouble anyone.
historia: Historia is a two-time BPL champion and a Diamond-tier flex player for Infernum E-Sports, a Singaporean whose titles bookend several years — from Bot Pro League Minor 7 in 2021 to the 2022 Conquerors Stage. Versatile and experienced, he remains a reliable veteran presence for the club.
jenapoppins: jenapoppins is a two-time BPL Legends Stage champion with New Jade, a Singaporean rifler who has been part of the club's title-winning core in both 2022 and 2025. An Emerald-tier fragger with a tidy 1.15 K/D, she is a steady contributor on one of the league's decorated sides.
